notes.title: TK patch 1.01
notes.content:
The patch notes for the November 25th, 2015 update, version "TK patch 1.01" are as follows:

- Fixed a bug where certain skills are stronger than normal, when players choose a specific color variant of Watson.
- Victory scenes can now be skipped during network play.
- Players can now choose from a wider range of Display Resolutions, depending on their graphics board.
- Fixed issue where higher resolutions were previously just "up-scaled" versions of lower resolutions, and now display correctly as of the indicated resolutions.
- Shortened the countdown timer for Rank match from 10 seconds to 3 seconds.
- Added new Motion Blur feature to the Launcher settings.

notes.title: アップデート＃１
notes.content:
- ランチャーに各種のグラフィック設定の切り替え機能を追加しました。
- ゲーム内のボタン設定を復活させました。

長らくお待たせしまして大変申し訳ございませんでした。
引き続きアップデートが続きますので、何卒宜しくお願い致します。

notes.title: Contents Upgrade Patch #1
notes.content:
- Added a new function to the launcher to allow users to toggle On/Off for various graphics effects.
- Added back the in-game Buttons Settings function.

For customers experiencing micro-stuttering issues, kindly set the game's resolution to match that of your current screen's resolution. If problem persists, consider turning off several of the graphics features for better performance.

If problem still persists then, kindly notify us here. Thank you for your cooperation.

More updates to come, a little slowly but surely.
